title: 野外实习与外出采样安全
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/154_野外实习与外出采样安全.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/154_野外实习与外出采样安全/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣背着背包、戴遮阳帽站在山路口
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a backpack and a sun hat at the start of a mountain trail, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第13章第八课：野外实习与外出采样安全。
overlay: 野外实习与外出采样安全

shots.scene: 欣欣指着远处的山林和河流
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at distant forested hills and a river.
shots.narration: 走出实验室，安全也要跟着走。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着采样瓶，一个人准备出门
shots.prompt_en: The young male student packs sampling bottles into a bag alone in a university laboratory, ready to leave.
shots.narration: 阿杰想一个人去河边采水样。

shots.scene: 窗外乌云密布
shots.prompt_en: Outside the window, dark storm clouds gather over the hills.
shots.narration: 天气预报说，下午有雷雨。

shots.scene: 小研拦住他，拿出一张空白报备表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him at the door and holds up a blank trip registration form.
shots.narration: 小研：报备了吗？跟谁一起去？

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, a question mark above him.
shots.narration: 阿杰这才发现，什么都没准备。

shots.scene: 报备表交给老周签字
shots.prompt_en: The older man signs a blank field trip registration form handed over by the young male student.
shots.narration: 出发前，向导师和学院报备。

shots.scene: 地图上标出路线和时间
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a map with a planned route, sampling points and a clock for return time. No text.
shots.narration: 写清地点、路线、人员和返回时间。

shots.scene: 行前安全培训
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator gives a short safety briefing to a group of students with backpacks.
shots.narration: 参加行前安全培训，了解风险。

shots.scene: 保险和应急联系人卡片
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank insurance card and a blank emergency contact card with a phone icon. No text.
shots.narration: 按规定办好保险，留好紧急联系人。

shots.scene: 一个人进山打叉，两三人一组
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single hiker going into the forest crossed out, and a group of three hikers together. No text.
shots.narration: 至少两人结伴，不单独行动。

shots.scene: 队伍清点人数
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a group leader counting team members with a check list, everyone present. No text.
shots.narration: 出发、收队都要清点人数。

shots.scene: 手机上的天气预报和预警图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone showing a weather forecast with storm and warning icons, no words. No text.
shots.narration: 出发前查天气预报和预警。

shots.scene: 雷雨、山洪、大风时不出发
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: lightning, a flash flood in a valley and strong wind, with a stop hand. No text.
shots.narration: 雷雨、山洪、大风，就改期。

shots.scene: 正规车辆、系好安全带
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: students riding in a licensed bus wearing seat belts, an overloaded truck crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 坐正规车辆，系好安全带。

shots.scene: 犯困司机打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sleepy driver at the wheel crossed out, and a driver change at a rest stop. No text.
shots.narration: 不疲劳驾驶，不坐超载车。

shots.scene: 手机查询当地疫情公告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone showing a blank public health notice with a mosquito and a tick icon. No text.
shots.narration: 出发前，先查当地疫情。

shots.scene: 长袖长裤、扎紧裤脚
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hiker in long sleeves and long trousers with trouser legs tucked into socks and high boots. No text.
shots.narration: 穿长袖长裤，扎紧裤脚。

shots.scene: 驱避剂、蚊帐
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottle of insect repellent spray and a mosquito net over a bed. No text.
shots.narration: 备好驱避剂和蚊帐。

shots.scene: 早晚和林边水边蚊子多
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a forest edge and a pond at dusk with swarms of mosquitoes. No text.
shots.narration: 早晚和林边水边，更要防叮咬。

shots.scene: 回来检查身体是否有蜱虫
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person checking behind the knees, waist and hairline for ticks with a magnifier. No text.
shots.narration: 回来检查身上，有没有蜱虫。

shots.scene: 蜱虫叮在皮肤上，不硬拽，去医院
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tick attached to skin, a hand pulling it hard crossed out, an arrow to a clinic. No text.
shots.narration: 发现蜱虫叮咬，别硬拽，就医处理。

shots.scene: 用棍子打草探路，穿高帮鞋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hiker in high boots tapping tall grass with a stick ahead on the path. No text.
shots.narration: 草丛里打草探路，防蛇咬。

shots.scene: 被蛇咬：不切不吸，少动，送医
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bitten ankle kept still, a knife and mouth sucking crossed out, an ambulance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 被蛇咬别切别吸，少动，尽快送医。

shots.scene: 野生动物和动物尸体，徒手接触打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bare hand reaching toward a wild rodent and a dead bird, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 野外动物，别徒手碰。

shots.scene: 可能携带人兽共患病原
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a wild animal with germ icons and an arrow to a person. No text.
shots.narration: 它们可能带人兽共患的病原。

shots.scene: 戴手套、用工具采集动物样本
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in thick gloves using long tongs to place an animal sample into a container. No text.
shots.narration: 采动物样本，戴手套用工具。

shots.scene: 登记来源和接触史
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank sample log being filled in next to labeled sample tubes. No text.
shots.narration: 来源和接触史，如实登记。

shots.scene: 野外挖坑取土样
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: students digging a soil sampling pit in a field with shovels. No text.
shots.narration: 挖坑取样，也有风险。

shots.scene: 先报备挖掘计划，了解地下管线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank dig plan with an underground pipe and cable icon beneath the ground. No text.
shots.narration: 先报备计划，问清地下管线。

shots.scene: 结伴，一人在坑边看护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one person in a shallow pit while a partner watches from the edge. No text.
shots.narration: 结伴行动，有人在坑边看护。

shots.scene: 一个人下深坑打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a single person climbing down into a deep pit with unstable walls, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不单独下深坑。

shots.scene: 土堆离坑边远一点
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a soil pile placed well away from the pit edge, distance arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 挖出的土，堆得离坑边远点。

shots.scene: 河边湖边采水样
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two students taking water samples at a river bank. No text.
shots.narration: 水边或水上采样，要防落水。

shots.scene: 【实拍】在岸上穿救生衣，扣好全部卡扣并拉紧（中景）
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot: a person on dry land puts on a life jacket, fastens all buckles and tightens the straps.
shots.narration: 穿好救生衣，扣好卡扣拉紧。

shots.scene: 船上采样，旁边备救生圈和船
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: students sampling from a small boat wearing life jackets, a life ring and a support boat nearby. No text.
shots.narration: 水上作业，旁边备好船和救生圈。

shots.scene: 湿滑岸边、雨后涨水，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a slippery muddy bank and a rising river after rain, a person wading in crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 湿滑岸边、涨水时，不下水。

shots.scene: 用长杆采样器站在稳处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person standing on firm ground using a long pole sampler to reach the water. No text.
shots.narration: 用长杆采样器，站稳再取样。

shots.scene: 手机、充电宝、哨子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone, a power bank and a whistle laid out on a table. No text.
shots.narration: 手机充满电，带上充电宝和哨子。

shots.scene: 【实拍】对照清单检查野外急救包（手部特写）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands check a field first aid kit item by item against a checklist, bandages, gauze and antiseptic wipes.
shots.narration: 出发前，对照清单检查急救包。

shots.scene: 约定联络时间，共享位置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone with a location pin shared to a supervisor and a clock for check in. No text.
shots.narration: 约定联络时间，共享位置。

shots.scene: 迷路后原地等待，拨打求救
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lost hiker staying put, blowing a whistle and calling on the phone. No text.
shots.narration: 迷路了别乱走，原地求救。

shots.scene: 发生意外先救人再报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a team helping an injured member, then calling the supervisor. No text.
shots.narration: 出了意外，先救人，再报告导师。

shots.scene: 样品瓶密封、贴标签
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: sample bottles sealed with caps and blank labels, placed upright in a cool box. No text.
shots.narration: 样品密封，贴好标签。

shots.scene: 固定液、酒精少量带，放二次容器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: small bottles of fixative and alcohol inside a secondary container with absorbent pads. No text.
shots.narration: 固定液、酒精，少量带，装进二次容器。

shots.scene: 危险品带上公共交通，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bottle with a flammable warning sign carried onto a train, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 危险试剂，别随身带上公共交通。

shots.scene: 回到实验室，样品登记交接
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student registers returned samples in a log at the laboratory.
shots.narration: 回到实验室，样品登记交接。

shots.scene: 回来后发烧、皮疹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student at home with a thermometer icon and a red rash on the arm, a calendar a few days after a trip. No text.
shots.narration: 回来后发烧、出疹、乏力，要警惕。

shots.scene: 就医时告诉医生野外经历
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student telling a doctor about a forest trip and an insect bite, a speech bubble with a tree icon. No text.
shots.narration: 及时就医，说清去过哪、被什么咬过。

shots.scene: 同时告诉导师
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone message sent to a supervisor with a health icon. No text.
shots.narration: 同时告诉导师和同行的人。

shots.scene: 高温中暑另见
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blazing sun over a field with a water bottle and a sun hat. No text.
shots.narration: 户外高温防中暑，前面讲过。

shots.scene: 报备表、天气、同伴
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a signed form, a weather cloud and two hikers together. No text.
shots.narration: 行前报备，查天气，结伴出行。

shots.scene: 防蚊蜱蛇、救生衣、挖坑看护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of insect repellent, a life jacket and a pit with a watcher. No text.
shots.narration: 防叮咬、穿救生衣、挖坑有人看。

shots.scene: 手机急救包、样品箱、医生
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone with a first aid kit, a sealed sample box and a doctor icon. No text.
shots.narration: 带足通讯急救，回来不适就医。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在应急物资柜旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an emergency supplies cabinet and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：第14章，应急预案与应急准备。
